priority: P1 — proteger /dupla simular: garantir que a simulação de quatro bots permaneça isolada, use apenas monstros Normais, sobreviva às restaurações JSON e não crie sessões, locks, cartas ou progresso de jogadores.

behavior.simulator: simulateTag(seed) — four virtual seats, normal monsters only, chooseNPC, bounded decisions, JSON restoration every 13 decisions
behavior.output: tagSimulationMessage — team result, LP, turns, decisions and restoration count
behavior.persistence: No TagRecord, member lock, inventory grant or player progress is created.

testCoverage: Verifies the /dupla simular subcommand and ephemeral handler contract.
Verifies the simulator uses only tagNormalCardIds and playable low-level normal monsters.
Runs a deterministic four-bot simulation to terminal state and crosses JSON restore boundaries.
Confirms public projection contains no private hand, Deck or physical UID data.
Validates the Discord simulation embed and safe allowedMentions.
Snapshots player, collection, grant, deck, tag_session and tag_member tables before/after; requires no changes.

security.discord: command source contract + embed builder offline; sem token/guild/canal real

limitations: Não instancia Client Discord nem envia mensagem em guild real.
Não altera runtime, catálogo, certificações ou dados persistentes.
